scope: Three exact ArabicGuy 6.72 original-only menu builds with an authored console-only controller for the original native loader. Internet required; hardware untested.

actions.label: ArabicGuy
actions.firmwareEvidence: Original host explicitly identifies PS4 6.72. No other console or firmware inferred.

loaderEvidence.transport: Original browser-native ROP PL_loader; exact original sources fetched and verified by an authored controller, followed by native XHR from a verified Blob URL.

actions.license: No redistribution licence was established for this compiled menu. Preserve original authorship and host attribution; original upstream download only.
actions.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto V artwork for the ArabicGuy menu family
actions.imageDescription: Existing GTA V artwork reused from this menu family; not a screenshot or hardware verification of the exact build.
requirements: PS4 firmware 6.72 and GTA V game update 1.00; the game update is separate from console firmware.
No regional CUSA list was supplied for this exact build. Confirm the title ID and executable before using it.
Original 6.72 browser loader
Internet required; hardware untested.
Menu release is not independently established. The source button and file numbers identify the game build; they are not asserted as menu releases.
Download is the original pinned upstream file. No public mirror or redistribution licence is asserted. No payload was executed during review.
Use a fresh PS4 browser session after restarting the console. Prepare the original loader, then choose Load once. Do not combine this chain with an already running jailbreak or another menu.
This first-party controller fetches and verifies the pinned original WebKit, kernel, native loader and selected BIN. It does not use GoldHEN HTTP, a TCP sender or an external-host redirect.

The original loader reads the already verified BIN from a Blob URL. Its native code remains unchanged; the initial script-element request for BIN bytes is bypassed. Source success messages are not proof of execution.
